### Q1
No. The user rejected SQLite (node:sqlite) because ops backs up data/store.json with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files, and a binary file would break those checks. We keep the JSON file store and speed it up with debounced writes in src/store.ts.
### Q2
Yes, `src/legacy/`. It is vendored from the old logistics monolith, and the platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so any change would be lost.
### Q3
It goes in a top-level body field `sig`, the hex HMAC-SHA256 over the JSON body without `sig`. Before that we tried an `X-Signature` header, but the ERP API gateway strips every custom X- header, so the ERP saw everything as unsigned on staging.
### Q4
Port 9911. It moved from 8080 in an October infra move.
### Q5
For all new user-facing errors, `message` is in German because the packers UI shows it verbatim. `code` is English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English validation messages are left as they are.
### Q6
Austrian public holidays are hardcoded for 2026 and 2027 in src/services/holidays.ts. The deployment has no outbound internet, so they can't be fetched. The Easter-based dates were computed by me and the user should verify them, and 2028 onward must be added.
### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to any array payload and accepts only one event object per request. The user tried batching up to 50 events in September.
### Q8
No new npm packages, runtime or dev. Each one goes through a security review that takes about 6 weeks, so we use only what Node provides.
### Q9
It was never implemented here. The user ruled out caching ETAs because QA found a stale-ETA bug with a cached version. My local measurements showed ETA is only about 0.4 ms of an ~8 ms request, so a cache wouldn't fix the slowness anyway. calculateEta is computed fresh on every call, and pagination of GET /shipments is planned instead.
### Q10
There are 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30 s pause and no backoff. Only network errors, timeouts and 5xx are retried, and 4xx is not (my choice). The ERP dedups by event_id only within 2 minutes, and the worst case of about 70 s has to stay inside that window. A test guards this budget.
### Q11
Never log recipient names, addresses or phone numbers, and never log recipient objects. The DPO flagged this in last month's GDPR audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.
### Q12
Yes, "emits webhook on delivered" in test/events.test.ts. It fails about 1 in 5 CI runs because of a timer race in the fake notifier (OPS-412, owned by the platform team). If it is red, rerun once and do not edit the test.
### Q13
ATP numbers are validated strictly against UPU S10, including the check digit (see docs/carriers.md). All other carriers accept any non-empty value, loose on purpose, because strict checks once rejected valid DHL numbers for 2 days. The ATP check lives in src/lib/trackingNumber.ts and is called from validate.ts, so POST /import applies it too.
### Q14
Nothing needs building now. `fs.watch` stays silent on staging because the config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host and change events get lost. `fs.watchFile` (polling) works, which the user tried last week.
### Q15
Yes, GET /shipments/:id. The mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on added or missing fields, and the next mobile release is in January. Only the list endpoint gets `eta`, so no fields may be added to shipmentToApi, which both endpoints share.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker — autonomous feature work, user reviews at the end
<!-- gemkeeper ledger. Written for the next session. Keep it under ~120 lines. Edit in place. -->
Updated: 2026-11-17

## Mission
- parcel-tracker = Vienna warehouse shipment tracking (Node 24 runs TS directly, no build, zero deps). User gives tasks one by one, works autonomously, reviews everything at the end (user).
- Done so far (all uncommitted, 105 tests green): ERP payload field names fixed; debounced JSON store writes (store.ts: 200 ms window from first mutation, flush(), flushOnExit wired in server.ts; test/store-debounce.test.ts); request logging (router.ts, one `request` line: method, path w/o query, status, duration_ms; test/request-log.test.ts); list ETA (GET /shipments only); Austrian holidays in ETA; ATP S10 validation; ERP webhook signing; ERP retries.

## Rules
- (user) NO caching/memoization of ETAs, ever — QA found a stale-ETA bug with a cached version (list kept the old ETA after a new exception event) and a proper cache key got messy. calculateEta stays computed fresh on every call. Instead: paginate GET /shipments later (user, not started). Tests "is never stale" / "drops the eta" in test/shipments-list-eta.test.ts guard this.
- (user) GDPR (DPO flagged it in last month audit): NEVER log recipient names, addresses, phone numbers (no recipient objects in any log). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must stay EXACTLY as is (same fields, nothing added/removed): mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next mobile release is January. Only the list (GET /shipments) gets `eta`. Do not add fields to shipmentToApi (shared by both).
- (user) Do NOT modify src/legacy/ — vendored from the old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so changes vanish.
- (user) No new npm packages, dev ones included — each goes through security review (~6 weeks). Use only what Node provides.
- (user) Tracking-number validation: ATP = strict UPU S10 incl. check digit (docs/carriers.md); ALL other carriers = any non-empty value, loose on purpose (last year strict checks rejected valid DHL numbers for 2 days).
- (user) All NEW user-facing errors: `message` in German (shown verbatim in packers UI), `code` English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English validation messages left as is.
- (user) Flaky test "emits webhook on delivered" (test/events.test.ts, ~1 in 5 CI runs, timer race in fake notifier, OPS-412, platform team owns fix): if red, rerun once, do NOT edit the test.

## Decisions
- ERP retries (notify.ts postToErpWithRetry): 3 attempts total, fixed 30 s pause, no backoff, retry only network errors/timeouts/5xx (not 4xx — my choice); sleep injectable (user). Reason: ERP dedups by event_id only within 2 min; worst case last attempt starts at 2*(30s+5s timeout)=70s; a test guards this budget (raising delay/attempts/timeoutMs can break it). Notifier is fire-and-forget (`void notify`), retries never delay HTTP responses; retries are in-memory, lost on restart.
- ERP signing: top-level body field `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 over JSON body WITHOUT sig (sig appended last, key order kept); secret only from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET (user). If unset: send unsigned + one-time warn (my choice; keeps local sandbox working, ERP will 401 once ERP-1182 enforces).
- Austrian holidays: hardcoded 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts — because deployment has zero outbound internet (user). Easter-based dates computed by me, user should verify; 2028+ must be added.
- ATP validation lives in src/lib/trackingNumber.ts, called from validate.ts, so POST /import applies it too (per-line German errors) —
